tasks.prompt: A customer who returns an item on the day it is due is charged a late fee, though that return is on time. a return one day after the due date costs one late day

plan.title: Fix the late fee on a return
plan.goal: A customer who brings an item back on the day it is due is charged a late fee, but a return on that day is on time. Late fees must start on the day after the due date: a return on or before the due date costs no late fee, and a return one day after the due date costs one late day. Cover the fix with a test.
acceptance: a return on the due date costs no late fee
a return one day late costs one late day
a test covers the due date

tasks.title: Fix the late fee on a return

tasks.note: A planted bug in one module, and the hand rehearsal's card. The commit must change a tests/ file, but which one is the session's choice. Existing tests only use returns before the due date.

lessons.text: Money is integer cents everywhere in ts-rentals; format with formatCents only at the edge, in slips, invoices and CLI output.
Dates are ISO days; count and compare them with the helpers in src/util/dates.ts, never with Date arithmetic.
Each module keeps its tests in tests/<module>.test.ts; add a helper's test to the file of the module that owns it.
Read a customer's tier through membership.ts (isMember, memberDiscountPercent), not by comparing the tier string.
